name: Shaddam IV
text:
[When Played:] Create 2 Spice tokens.
[When Played/On Attack:] You may defeat any number of friendly Spice tokens. For each one, choose one (you may choose the same option more than once):
• Deal 3 damage to an enemy unit.
• Deal 1 damage to an enemy base.
• Give 2 Experience tokens to a friendly unit with no upgrades.
subtitle: Lion Throne
